name: piSensors
func:
// 1. Assign the incoming MQTT payload to a variable
let d = msg.payload;

// 2. Prepare the formatted object for Stackhero InfluxDB v2
// This will be sent to the 28th output
let influxMsg = {
    payload: {
        bucket: 'your_bucket_name',      // <-- REPLACE with your bucket name
        measurement: 'sensor_data',      // The "table" name in Influx
        fields: {                        // Numerical values
            therm1: d.therm1,
            therm2: d.therm2,
            therm3: d.therm3,
            therm4: d.therm4,
            therm5: d.therm5,
            therm6: d.therm6,
            therm7: d.therm7,
            therm8: d.therm8,
            therm9: d.therm9,
            therm10: d.therm10,
            trans1_psi: d.trans1_psi,
            trans2_psi: d.trans2_psi,
            trans3_psi: d.trans3_psi,
            volt1: d.volt1,
            volt2: d.volt2,
            volt3: d.volt3,
            volt4: d.volt4,
            volt5: d.volt5,
            volt6: d.volt6,
            volt7: d.volt7,
            ax: d.ax,
            ay: d.ay,
            az: d.az,
            gx: d.gx,
            gy: d.gy,
            gz: d.gz,
            imu_temp: d.imu_temp
        },
        tags: {                          // Metadata for filtering
            device: "raspberry_pi",
            source: "c_program"
        },
        timestamp: Date.now()            // Uses current system time
    }
};

// 3. Send to the 28 outputs
// Outputs 1-27 are individual topics, Output 28 is the InfluxDB object
node.send([
    { payload: d.therm1,     topic: "Therm 1 (C)"    },  // 1
    { payload: d.therm2,     topic: "Therm 2 (C)"    },  // 2
    { payload: d.therm3,     topic: "Therm 3 (C)"    },  // 3
    { payload: d.therm4,     topic: "Therm 4 (C)"    },  // 4
    { payload: d.therm5,     topic: "Therm 5 (C)"    },  // 5
    { payload: d.therm6,     topic: "Therm 6 (C)"    },  // 6
    { payload: d.therm7,     topic: "Therm 7 (C)"    },  // 7
    { payload: d.therm8,     topic: "Therm 8 (C)"    },  // 8
    { payload: d.therm9,     topic: "Therm 9 (C)"    },  // 9
    { payload: d.therm10,    topic: "Therm 10 (C)"   },  // 10
    { payload: d.trans1_psi, topic: "Trans 1 (PSI)"  },  // 11
    { payload: d.trans2_psi, topic: "Trans 2 (PSI)"  },  // 12
    { payload: d.trans3_psi, topic: "Trans 3 (PSI)"  },  // 13
    { payload: d.volt1,      topic: "Volt 1 (V)"     },  // 14
    { payload: d.volt2,      topic: "Volt 2 (V)"     },  // 15
    { payload: d.volt3,      topic: "Volt 3 (V)"     },  // 16
    { payload: d.volt4,      topic: "Volt 4 (V)"     },  // 17
    { payload: d.volt5,      topic: "Volt 5 (V)"     },  // 18
    { payload: d.volt6,      topic: "Volt 6 (V)"     },  // 19
    { payload: d.volt7,      topic: "Volt 7 (V)"     },  // 20
    { payload: d.ax,         topic: "Accel X (g)"    },  // 21
    { payload: d.ay,         topic: "Accel Y (g)"    },  // 22
    { payload: d.az,         topic: "Accel Z (g)"    },  // 23
    { payload: d.gx,         topic: "Gyro X (dps)"   },  // 24
    { payload: d.gy,         topic: "Gyro Y (dps)"   },  // 25
    { payload: d.gz,         topic: "Gyro Z (dps)"   },  // 26
    { payload: d.imu_temp,   topic: "IMU Temp (C)"   },  // 27
    influxMsg                                            // 28
]);
